historical_reviews.deepseek: The three selected properties cannot establish all BMC manager information, and unsafe transport plus user visual diff leaves identity, schema and completeness unproven.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly changes the conclusion because execution readiness depends on the complete field contract rather than merely having a readable endpoint.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The Manager endpoint is both inventory and live controller state. Each SPEC field needs provenance, freshness and semantics; FirmwareVersion and Model are not a completeness proxy, and PowerState may be absent or refer to the manager rather than chassis power.

original_test_intent: Validate every required BMC manager information field displayed in Inventory and LEDs against the approved same-controller SPEC without changing manager state.
original_method: Bind the BMC Manager resource and Web page to the exact SUT/chassis, capture the complete supported manager representation with synchronized UI evidence, normalize all approved identity, firmware, status, service, time and availability fields, compare each to the owner SPEC/schema including missing/stale rules, and verify the read caused no configuration change.
manual_activity: The owner supplies and approves the full manager field contract; an operator confirms UI-only presentation or documented exceptions and owns the final verdict.
required_inputs: Manager resource URI and firmware/UI version
safety_requirements: Do not change manager power, network, users, services, firmware or time
Do not accept a three-field subset as complete coverage
Reject cached, stale, cross-host or alias-ambiguous data
Do not automatically retry an inconsistent response
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact target and Manager URI
Capture complete raw supported Manager resource and UI evidence
Normalize every approved field with freshness metadata
Report missing or ambiguous evidence without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Manager SPEC/schema and exception rules
Confirm UI-only fields and resource aliases

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The GET is relevant but the jq projection discards most manager data, uses `-k` and inline credentials, and cannot compare fields or UI presentation against the absent SPEC.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected full-resource retrieval plus same-session UI capture, then apply the approved complete Manager field/schema matrix with explicit freshness and availability handling.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC manager information and 2/2-minute estimates remain; all required fields replace the arbitrary three-property subset.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a normalized table containing field path, UI label, raw value, expected value/rule, freshness/provenance and comparison result while retaining the full raw payload.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns a subjective page check into complete deterministic evidence without changing state.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three common Redfish properties cannot represent vendor extensions, status, services, time or UI-only manager fields required by SPEC.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Vendor schemas may alias or omit properties by firmware version; using a generic schema can report false matches unless the exact controller version is pinned.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define which Manager fields and UI-only values constitute all information and how unavailable/stale properties are accepted. Chassis inventory remains the following separate row and cannot substitute.
expected_evidence: Exact SUT/BMC/chassis and Manager identity, firmware/UI version and approved field matrix
Complete protected raw Manager response and synchronized UI capture
Per-field normalized expected/actual comparison with provenance and freshness
Missing, stale, malformed, alias and mismatch report
Audit/SEL review, exceptions and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require BMC manager information versus SPEC. DeepSeek undercovers that scope but does not expose a Master contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The full SPEC, vendor schema and protected access are normal project inputs. The read-only comparison can be defined once they are supplied.

review_improvement: Expands a three-field unsafe query into complete same-controller manager evidence with deterministic field, identity and freshness checks while preserving read-only behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: Manager inventory mixes stable identity with dynamic operational properties. A value can be syntactically valid yet stale, sourced from the wrong controller or semantically misread. Field-level provenance and synchronized UI/API capture distinguish schema correctness from mere endpoint reachability and prevent partial data from being called complete.
